question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE month_num
    WHEN 1 THEN 'January'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'February'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'March'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'July'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'August'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'September'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'October'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'November'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'December'
  END AS month,
  CAST(SUM(cnt_2016) AS INTEGER) AS orders_2016,
  CAST(SUM(cnt_2017) AS INTEGER) AS orders_2017,
  CAST(SUM(cnt_2018) AS INTEGER) AS orders_2018
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CAST(strftime('%m', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
    CASE strftime('%Y', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))
      WHEN '2016' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS cnt_2016,
    CASE strftime('%Y', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))
      WHEN '2017' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS cnt_2017,
    CASE strftime('%Y', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))
      WHEN '2018' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS cnt_2018
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND strftime('%Y', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
)
GROUP BY month_num
ORDER BY month_num
